title: Website Security Plan Charge Counted in a Hosting Prefund
content:
# Security plan charge of the prefund

The security plan the prefund counts is the site security plan whose site runs on the plan, active with auto-renew on, when its next auto-renew attempt is today or no more than 14 calendar days after today; a security plan has no retry days, so its single attempt day is the security charter's renewal day before its term end. Because its site runs on an active Harborline plan, its charge is reduced by the higher of the product's hosted-site discount and the account tier's security discount, the two never added, the discount being the charge less the reduced charge rounded half up to the cent. The security plan charge of the prefund follows the security plan's billing term: a 12-month term is priced at its annual price, a 1-month term at its monthly price, and otherwise no security plan charge is counted. The charge so found enters the credit the prefund must cover.

**Decision card**

| Due within the 14 days | Billing term | Charge counted | Discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 months | annual price | higher of hosted-site and tier security discount |
| yes | 1 month | monthly price | higher of hosted-site and tier security discount |
| no | any | none | none |

*Hypothetical:* annual price $89.00, hosted-site discount 12 percent, tier security discount 20 percent: 20 percent applies alone, the reduced charge $71.20.

*Applies to: Harborline Customer Accounts. Concerns the Website Security plan whose site runs on the hosting plan a prefund deposit carries.*
